label: A weighted objective as configuration
subgoals: Convert each metric to wirelength-equivalent units with its weight
Sum the weighted terms for each run's cost
Change weights through configuration without rebuilding

label: Comparing runs
subgoals: Compute both runs' costs under the same weights
Take the difference to pick the cheaper run
Report how sensitive the choice is to the weights

label: The break-even weight
subgoals: Set the two runs' costs equal
Solve for the weight at the crossover
Escalate to a plug-in when no weight setting satisfies the request
